Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 7

“Whenever there is a decline of righteousness, Bharata, and a rise of unrighteousness, then I send forth myself.”

One of the most quoted promises in Indian thought. The trigger is not wickedness in general but glani, a wearing-thin of dharma — a slow failure rather than a sudden crime.
